doc.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022

title: Residual checks from film and TV
summary: Still receiving checks for a Budweiser commercial seen in Close Encounters.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Do you ever get checks in the mail and you’re not sure what they’re for?

That’s happened to me, yes, yes. From films. Usually from films. Like I remember, oh I still get a check from what was that Spielberg movie “Close Encounters” “Close Encounters.” Now get this: you remember the scene in the movie where he’s building a mountain inside of his house?

There’s a TV on and they’re playing a Budweiser commercial that I’m on. So I get a check for like 90 bucks every once in a while, 95 bucks. At first I didn’t know what it was and then I found out. Because it was weird, it was like I didn’t do the film, I was just on — the TV was playing in the room while he was building a house.
It’s weird, isn’t it? It’s weird.
